{
  "id": "claude-quota",
  "name": "Quota Claude",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "api": 1,
  "author": "KingsRequin",
  "description": "Quota de l'abonnement Claude (session de 5 h, semaine, limites par modèle), lu à l'API d'Anthropic avec la connexion de Claude Code.",
  "icon": "chartDonut",
  "widget": { "squeeze": 9 },
  "panel": true,
  "permissions": {
    "files": ["%USERPROFILE%/.claude/.credentials.json"],
    "http": ["https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage"],
    "events": ["presence"]
  }
}
